messages:
maria: quick question — for the SDK surfaces across py/ts/go: how should we present retry windows/policies when a consumer uses paginated endpoints vs streaming ones? trying to avoid surprising defaults.
aj: short answer: surface a RetryPolicy object but keep small ergonomic defaults per language. streaming needs stricter idempotency rules. :thinking:
sasha: agree. also we should distinguish per-request vs per-page retries. per-page retry can re-fetch a page idempotently; per-request retry for unary calls is simpler.
kevinw: language ergonomics: in Go people expect RetryPolicy on client options, TS/py folks want per-call overrides in opts param. don't force same call-site shape across languages.
tim: operational concern — retries on paginated calls can duplicate items if server doesn't preserve offsets. we need to recommend resume-token based pagination for safety. mention to API owners.
maria: good point. Example we discussed earlier: cursor-based paging + retry = safe. offset based + retry = risky unless server dedups. we should document that.
aj: proposed runtime shim: transport adapter exposes a "retryContext" with two knobs: {scope: "call" | "page" | "stream-chunk", allowReorder: bool}. SDKs map RetryPolicy to it.
sasha: sketch for config:```yaml
retry:
  max_attempts: 3
  backoff: exponential
  scope: page
  idempotent: true
```
kevinw: for streaming (server-sent chunks) scope should be "stream-chunk" and default max_attempts=1 because re-requesting a chunk often impossible. instead rely on reconnect+resume-token.
tim: +1. Also we should expose a way to mark individual RPCs as idempotent in generated surface so we can default scope. e.g., in spec: x-sdk-idempotency: cursor-pagination
maria: how about API shape examples? TS:```ts
client.listWidgets({ pageSize: 100, retry: { maxAttempts: 2, scope: 'page' } })
```Go:```go
client.ListWidgets(ctx, &ListOpts{PageSize:100}, WithRetry(Policy{Max:2, Scope:Page}))
```py:```py
client.list_widgets(page_size=100, retry=Retry(max_attempts=2, scope='page'))
```
aj: those shapes look fine. Keep names small: scope -> 'retry_scope' maybe. Also make defaults conservative: paged endpoints default to page-scope if cursor-based, unary to call-scope, streaming to none.
sasha: docs should include a small decision table: cursor+resume -> page-scope ok; offset -> avoid per-page retry; streaming with resume-token -> allow resume on reconnect not retrying chunks.
kevinw: edge-case: aggregated endpoints that return partial results over pages (like getAll) — we should provide a helper that does de-duplicated concat when safe. maybe builtin helper in SDK: client.iterateAll with dedupe option.
tim: agree. For telemetry, surface retry_reason tags (per-page vs per-call) so Console can show where costs came from.
maria: TL;DR propose: (1) spec annotation for idempotency/pagination type, (2) retryContext shim with scope, (3) conservative defaults per language, (4) doc + helper for de-duping iteration. anyone object?
aj: no objections. I'll draft a short RFC blurb. (reaction :thumbsup: by aj)
sasha: I'll add code samples for py/ts/go in the doc.
kevinw: I'll prototype the Go options pattern and make sure it composes with context.
devx-bot: NOTE: action items created — RFC draft assigned to aj, code samples to sasha, Go prototype to kevinw. Due: next Tuesday. (link: https://rfc.internal/123) :eyes:
